entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "legs and glowing tubes"

Read "Vacuum Fluorescent Display Clock": those little glowing tubes run on hot filaments and grid voltage just like the old radio valves.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "vfd driver schemas"
Idea: use a vfd tube for the main manifold pressure readout on the dash
Read "IV-12 (ИB-12) Vacuum Fluorescent Display Clock": six russian iv-12 vacuum fluorescent tubes can make a glowing display for next to nothing if you dig through surplus bins.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "testing the power bus"
Idea: build a compact mosfet testing rig for the little dart's battery banks
Read "Raspberry Pi Controlled DC Load – Dr. Scott M. Baker": a raspberry pi and a big mosfet make a fine dc load for testing power supplies.
wiringdigital.com wouldn't open, so he searched for "Vfd Display Circuit - Wiring Digital and Schematic" instead.
tapping through wire links to check vfd filament voltage curves
entries.why: i need to see how those old circuits handle the negative rail without frying the glass tubes.
